The animal that says 'meow' is a cat.

The text contains a social engineering tactic known as **pretexting**. The attacker creates a fabricated scenario (meeting at a conference, expressing interest in work) to build false rapport and trust. They then use a plausible excuse (potential investor interest) to justify the request for sensitive information (the project proposal preview), aiming to lower the victim's guard and extract valuable data under the guise of a legitimate business opportunity.
